revisionNote: Integrates the actual session driver, finite programme admission, real transport capture, F7 replay and diagnostic exports. Retains unchanged corpus, calibration inputs, historical baseline and original token endpoint. Adds one development live pair to the costed schedule. Human verdicts are sanity-check labels only.
status: pre-pilot driver candidate; independent measured-series execution requires its later freeze
revisionPolicy: Pre-pilot drafts may rebind before capture. Each executed series binds exact source commit and input hashes; no existing run is relabelled when a later draft changes.

historicalInputsUnchanged.rule: Historical hashes, exposure labels and acceptance files remain unchanged. The new corpus and calibration packet are also unchanged from their reviewed hashes.

measurementPrerequisiteEvidence.result: One no-tool response had all input/cache fields and response-ID correlation. Every study response still requires its own evidence.
measurementPrerequisiteEvidence.endpointDerivation: max(0, input_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens), with all three wire fields required
measurementPrerequisiteEvidence.secondaryEndpoint: Total input has an independent completeness rule and paired analysis. Development/pilot exports are diagnostic only.

humanLabels.scope: Four A verdicts; owner criticism of triviality retained. Sanity checks, not judge validation. No repeat review requested.

beforeDevelopmentAndPilotCapture: Independent review and passing gates admit the first CS-DEV-01 capture, replay pair and live pair as bounded verification; inspect those outcomes before remaining development/pilot work
beforeQualityClaims: Source-backed blinded scoring by both prescribed judges, retained disagreements and calibration limitations
beforeMeasuredSeriesCapture: Pilot followed by the measured-series-1 freeze: final population, margins, stopping rule and intended claims

freezeRule: After measured-series-1, changes to population, endpoints, order, margins or judging need a new declared revision. Failed trials and prior exposure labels are retained.
